title: Heavy Lifting
description:
S01 E03 — Bridging the Gap
A crane operator encounters a tricky setup on a site; a father and son team makes a family's dreams come true.

title: Secrets of the Factories
description:
S01 E03 — Secrets Of Mr. Kipling Cakes
The Mr. Kipling factory in Carlton, near Barnsley in Yorkshire, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favorite cakes are made in one of Britain's biggest factories - which is also the biggest cake factory Europe.

title: Secrets of the Factories
description:
S01 E04 — Secrets Of Kellogg's Cereals
The Kellogg's factory in Manchester opens its doors to reveal step by step how some of the nation's favorite breakfast cereals are made in the biggest cereals factory in Europe, and the largest producer of cornflakes in the world.

title: The Flying Kestrel
description:
S01 E06 — The Renovation Diaries
The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel, with the intention of restoring it and then breaking the land-speed record.

title: The Ship Sinkers
description: Decommissioned naval vessels are submerged to provide artificial reefs.

title: Proof of Concept
description:
S01 E04 — The Infinite
Kyle Hill and Eugenia Cheng join the show to prove there is more than one infinity, that infinity is hidden all around us and that we might actually be infinite ourselves.

title: Digits
description:
S01 E03 — Guardians of the Web
A look at the U.S. Secret Service's cyber crime division.

title: Extremes
description:
S01 E04 — Largest Animals, Human Bodies and Football
We explore the largest animals, extreme facts about the human body and record-breaking extremes in football and the field of music.

title: TechKnow
description:
The Science Of The Senses
A look into the mechanics of taste and smell with an exploration of the global flavor industry and the science of creating new flavors and smells.

title: TechKnow
description:
Curing Cancer
An innovative gene therapy has produced a significant breakthrough that could lead to a cure for cancer.

title: TechKnow
description:
The Longevity Gene
Studying the genes and lifestyles of centenarians; the results may offer answers to living longer and fighting diseases.

title: Disruptive Behaviour
description: Reuben Christian travels to Istanbul to meet the innovators who are changing the city and discover how technology is disrupting the old order.

title: Supersonic: The Great Adventure
description: Recounting 70 years of human and technological challenges from Chuck Yeager's successful breaking of the sound barrier in 1947 to high-performance supersonic fighter jets to the recent NASA advances and civilian jet projects.

title: The Demolition Man
description:
S01 E07 — Bath
An intensive operation takes place to bring down a beast of a building in Harworth Colliery.

title: The Demolition Man
description:
S01 E08 — Doncaster
An intensive operation takes place to bring down a huge and unusual structure.

title: The Demolition Man
description:
S01 E09 — Liverpool
The sheer size of these buildings automatically makes this a very difficult job, but the towers are also surrounded by hundreds of homes.

title: Around the World in 80 Tricks
description:
S01 E10 — The Best Of...
In the episode you can see the best of `Around the World in 80 Tricks'.

title: Droners
description:
S01 E01 — Guerilla Droners
From New York to Hong Kong, FPV crews cover underground races and meet key players in the emerging drone community.

title: Droners
description:
S01 E02 — Kid Droners
A behind-the-scenes look at an international racing tournament during which young pilots climb the ranks and rake in the cash along the way.

title: Droners
description:
S01 E03 — Freestyle Droners
What it takes to be a freestyle drone pilot, racing cars, flying up mountains and exploring abandoned buildings.

title: Megastructures
description:
Gardens by the Bay
Singapore's ambitious greening project which includes massive gardens and conservatories.

title: Singapore's Field of Dreams
description: Building the world's ultimate multifunction sports complex; costing more than a billion US dollars, the ambitious project includes an indoor aquatics center that can hold up to 6,000 people, a multipurpose arena, water sports center, and shopping.

title: Survival Science
description:
S01 E01 — Surviving a Bear Attack
Nick and Laura create tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears; they use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack and then try to recreate a miracle arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

title: Survival Science
description:
S01 E02 — Surviving Treestand Accidents
Finding out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how one can prevent them; cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send the hosts, stunt team and special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

title: Survival Science
description:
S01 E03 — Sniper Attack
In addition to marksmanship and long-range shooting, military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

title: Connections With Alie Ward
description:
S01 E06 — Becoming Bionic
A discovery in a gold mine in the Ural Mountains leads to a vivid paint that revolutionizes art and stuns the world; from dissecting stolen corpses and peering into microscopes, the secret structure of the brain and nervous system is exposed.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S03 E10 — Second Annual Student Astronaut Contest
High-school and college students go aboard a zero-G aircraft and experience microgravity.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S03 E11 — Space Bots
When venturing into deep space to discover new worlds, robots are needed to first explore the extreme environments.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S03 E12 — Space Shuttle Documentary
The Space Shuttle program accomplishes many things in low-Earth orbit.

Climbing aboard some of the world's fastest theme park rides to learn what it takes to build them.

description:

Discovering how the fear of falling is exploited by some of the world's top theme park rides to create a thrilling experience.

Neil Cairns visits ITER in France, where nuclear fusion could provide unlimited clean energy, to see progress and challenges firsthand.

Research shows sanitized cities reduce beneficial microbes, harming health and increasing allergies and autoimmune diseases.

Over the centuries, scientific theories have emerged that rival religious cosmology in terms of ambition and scope.

Air traffic control; en route control; Boundary Bay, B.C., air show; Beech Staggerwing; aviation advocacy.

description:

Aircraft auction; ultralight flying; aviation destination -- Wichita, Kan.

title: The Aviators
description:
S01 E11 — Blimp
Mikey McBryan of "Ice Pilots"; Goodyear blimp; Midnight Sun Challenge into the Yukon.

title: Backyard Ballistics
description:
S01 E01 — Cannon Carnage
Jörg and Cheyenne are challenged to build a rubber powered cannon; Jörg is particularly excited about the carnage they are going to be able to create.

title: Backyard Ballistics
description:
S01 E02 — Javelin Launcher
Jorg and Cheyenne build a javelin launcher; Jorg sets out exactly how he thinks they should do it, using his trusty rubber bands and wooden build.

title: Backyard Ballistics
description:
S01 E03 — Super Stone Skimmer
Jörg and Cheyenne are challenged to build machines that skim stones across a lake; Jörg has built thousands of slingshots so he can easily fling stones, but whether he can make them skim across water is a different story.

title: Sci Q
description:
Pop Sci Test
Fast-paced pop-science show to test I.Q.

title: Sci Q
description:
S01 E07 — Sci Q's and A's
Answering the questions: Where's the hottest place on Earth? Where's the coldest place? Is it true that a jellyfish has neither a heart nor brain? And what exactly is a supernova?

title: Strange World
description:
Ice Bombs
Alex searches for a scientific explanation for the terrifying phenomenon known as ice bombs, which cause fear, devastation and even injury.

title: Strange World
description:
Alien Sounds
Mysterious, alien sky sounds terrify Canadian residents, who struggle to locate their source.

title: Strange World
description:
Bird Apocolypse
Alex Hannaford heads to the US to investigate a 'bird apocalypse', where it rained blackbirds.

title: Battle Factory
description:
S01 E03 — Sniper Rifle/Zeppelin/Ka-Bar Knife/Dragon Eggs
The AX-338 Sniper Rifle, the most accurate weapon on earth, is formed from a block of metal in 48 hours.

title: Battle Factory
description:
S01 E04 — Amphibious Armored Vehicle, Bomb Robot and Life Raft
Through snow, sand, or water, the armored amphibious personnel carrier Viking BVS10 can get troops in and out of any combat zone; a steel plated hull becomes fitted with controls and tracks.

title: Battle Factory
description:
S01 E05 — Helmet/Zippo/Fuel Bladder/Simulated IED
Up until the mid-1990s, helmets hadn't evolved far from World War I, until a series of delicate, snowflake-shaped sheets of Aramid were pressed together to form a piece of headgear comfortable enough to wear and tough enough to take a bullet.

title: Skuld: A Look Into the Future
description:
S01 E16 — Fuel Cell Cars
Skuld is the magazine series that explores the ideas and innovations shaping our world.

title: Skuld: A Look Into the Future
description:
S01 E17 — World Solar Challenge
Take a look at a solar car competition. Teams from around the world build their own pure solar model and compete in a race across Australia.

title: Skuld: A Look Into the Future
description:
S01 E18 — The Trucks of the Future
Let's explore the mobility of the future in truck and goods transport; electric trucks, new trends in the development of environmentally friendly forms of heavy transport.

title: Angry Planet
description:
S03 E10 — Crystal Cave
Miners in Chihuahua, Mexico, discover a chamber filled with blue and pink crystals, some as big as 60 feet long; as temperatures run to 150 F, with 100-percent humidity, the authorities are only opening up the cavern to scientists and film crews.

title: Angry Planet
description:
S03 E11 — 2009 Hurricane
The Angry Planet team will be tracking storms through the 2009 Hurricane season, and plan to film George as he heads into a big one.

title: Angry Planet
description:
Turkmenistan
The Angry Planet team hopes to film the natural wonders and extreme phenomena of this fascinating Central Asian country, including a burning crater of natural gas, underground lakes, sandstorms and remnants of the dinosaurs.

title: Top 10 The Art of Architecture
description:
S01 E03 — The Most Amazing Bridges
This episode is unique, and not just architecturally. The architecture, construction and geographic variety were the most important criteria in the final selection of the top ten of the most amazing bridges in the world.

title: Top 10 The Art of Architecture
description:
Transport Megastructures-Engineering Wonders
The Trans-Siberian Railway, New York City Subway, Channel Tunnel and Suez Canal are only some of the megastructures devised by humanity.

title: More Curious?
description:
S01 E10 — What Are Blades?
What is asphalt, and how is it used? What are blades? Discovering dishwashers and irons and exploring Greek mythology.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E19 — World Wide Wifi
Several space entrepreneurs and corporations are developing advanced networks of satellites.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E20 — Strange Space Recipes
Scientists are developing strange, cutting-edge ways to use naturally occurring resources like space rocks and astronaut blood to make deep space missions or long-term space colonies possible.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E16 — Space as a Tax Haven
The Panama Papers, offshore banking, Swiss banks and Dubai; for the ultra-wealthy, one of the fun parts of making money is avoiding taxes on it; whether it's mining asteroids or making rockets to reach them, space could be an astronomical payday.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E17 — Traveling So Fast Time Slows Down
As private space entrepreneurs develop superfast propulsion systems, it might one day be possible for a corporation to take full advantage of the time-bending science of special relativity.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E05 — Looting the Moon for Trillions of Dollars
The moon is rich in rare earths, metals, and the highly sought-after isotope Helium 3; with NASA planning to make a manned return trip to the moon by 2024, some giant corporation could turn moon dust into a cosmic-sized payday.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S05 E07 — Extreme Labs
The world's largest flying observatory; an underwater habitat nearly a mile underground.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S05 E08 — Highlights of Apollo
Celebrating the 50th anniversary of the moon landing; amazing footage; interviews with astronauts and historians.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S05 E11 — Student Astronaut Contest: Russia
Host Emily Calandrelli holds the fourth annual Student Astronaut Contest; one student will win a trip to Russia to train like a cosmonaut at the Yuri Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Center.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E01 — From Here to There
The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies; in them, humans can read not only their origin, but also their final destination; technology is on the brink of taking the human race to places it has only dreamed of.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E02 — Return to the Moon
The moon is our closest celestial companion; it lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores; few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E03 — The Inner Worlds
They orbit between our planet and our star; Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them; as we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E04 — Next Stop Mars
Mars is now under robotic scrutiny with our sights set on a manned mission soon.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E05 — The Planet Makers
Scientists and engineers manage to land a spacecraft on a comet; knowledge of these celestial marauders may drive industrial expansion into deep space.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S02 E01 — Volcanoes
Scientists discover volcanoes on alien worlds and wonder whether life exists there.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S02 E02 — Megastorms
Examining chaotic weather to help determine whether we are alone in the universe.

title: Around the World in 80 Tricks
description:
S01 E01 — Paris & Barcelona
Bones introduces his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and attempting to escape from a straitjacket while breakdancing.

title: Around the World in 80 Tricks
description:
S01 E02 — London
Bones is back in his home city, London, where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card tricks and disappearing skills.

title: Around the World in 80 Tricks
description:
S01 E03 — South Korea - Night
Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

title: Silly Sustainability
description:
S01 E04 — K-Cups: Recycled Plastic into Shoes
K-Cups have made morning routines wonderfully easier, but they create a lot of excess waste; that's why Andy from "How to Make Everything" jumps on the opportunity to recycle them into something everyone needs: shoes.

title: Past, Present, Future
description:
S01 E08 — The Past, Present, and Future of Transportation
From empires to major metropolitan cities, transportation has been crucial.

description:
S01 E64 — First Human Link
A team of scientists believes there was a witness to the mass extinction of the dinosaurs who survived to allow humans to exist today.

title: Breakthrough
description:
Super Spider Silk
Science reveals new understanding of spiders, their super strong and flexible silks, and their predatory behavior.

title: Breakthrough
description:
S01 E66 — Secrets of a Dog's Nose
A dog's sense of smell can do amazing things; Dogs can help humans sniff out all kinds of things that improve our lives, explosives, missing persons, illegal drugs; now the latest research is revealing that dogs can detect disease, even cancer.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Roman Crane
The team attempts to build the Roman crane.
